portraits.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original playable HERO portrait from scratch for the dark gothic fantasy game Heroes of Orvesk. Deliver a single standalone full rectangular PNG 1024x1536 (2:3), not a sheet.
NON-NEGOTIABLE ANDROGYNY: adult human whose gender is visually ambiguous, a natural balance of soft and defined features. No beard, moustache, beard shadow, makeup, lipstick, eyeliner, exaggerated eyelashes, bulky masculine jaw, heavy masculine brow or prominent Adam's apple. No model glamour or sexualization. Readably adult, age accurate, ordinary human anatomy, no elf ears. Natural individuality, never caricature or exotic costume.
PAINTED ART DIRECTION: old gothic fantasy illustration, sculpturally modelled volume, deep chiaroscuro, tactile drawn painterly surfaces. Fine broken dry-brush strokes and scumbled half-tones FOLLOW the form. Face receives selective definition, peripheral hair and clothing are simplified. Matte skin has irregular PAINTED tonal planes, NOT photographic pores. Hair grouped into readable locks or masses; fabric large broken angular folds and rough edges. NO photorealism, photo with noise filter, smooth CGI, glossy wax, heavy impasto, flat vector, anime, cartoon or low-poly. Palette very muted graphite, grey-brown, aged linen and restrained natural skin undertones. One directional key light ABOVE FRONT IMAGE LEFT: face highlights, deep readable shadows; outer clothing dissolves into near-black charcoal background. No uniform rim lighting, neon, glow, magic, scenes or colored studio light.
COMPOSITION: three-quarter head looking distinctly toward IMAGE RIGHT (nose and eyes right), both eyes visible. Head horizontally centered rather than pushed to one edge. Canvas has deliberate dark headroom about 12% height. Top of main head/hair at y=184 (10–14% H), mean eye line at y=584 (36–40% H), lowest chin y=983 (61–67% H), head mass centered x=512 (47–53% W), head width about 70% W. Head and upper shoulders only, no waist or hands. No crop of head at canvas edges. Intended circular crop is source square x0..1024,y128..1152; keep eyes/nose/mouth/chin inside circle center(512,640), radius460.8. Do not draw guides/circle/numbers. Natural anatomy takes priority over distorted proportions.
Plain understated clothing specified below, distinct construction per character. Absolutely no armor, weapons, jewelry, emblems, headgear, props, frame, text or watermark. Quiet attentive expression, no grin. Opaque almost black charcoal background.
